class.name: GeometryComposer
class.brief_description: Tier 2 studio workspace unifying Geometry, Splines, and Tiles.
class.description: Orchestrates Tier 1 2D geometry, spline, and tile editors inside a single tabbed workspace with sidebar tabs for [b]General[/b] (Polygons, Voronoi, SDF Grids, Tensor Fields), [b]Splines[/b], and [b]Tiles[/b]. Exposes shared Fit View, Grid, and Y-Down viewport toggles in the command bar.

method.name: open_geometry_resource
method.description: Opens or focuses the shared [GeometryComposer] window and loads [param resource].
